# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at high effort, 2.0× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 59.3 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.8× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at medium effort; advanced reasoning → Fable 5.2 at high effort; cutting-edge thinking → Fable 5.2 at max effort. Highest measured quality: Fable 5.2 at max effort (expected score 76.5 %, cost 438× the cheapest couple).

Costs are at today's prices, as multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task, each traced to its source by its exact quote and URL, by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 356 sources · 1724 benchmarks · 7903 measurements. Updated 2026-11-19. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 1.6× to 2.4× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 2.4 to 6.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.5 %): Opus 5.5's best is max at 73.9 %. To match Opus 5.5 at max (73.9 %, cost 236×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is medium (73.2 %, cost 67×): 3.5× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 2.9× to 5.5× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 3.9 to 13.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.5 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 72.6 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.6 %, cost 150×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is low (71.8 %, cost 58×): 2.6× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 29× to 47× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 12.6 to 19.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.5 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.9 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.9 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is low (71.8 %, cost 58×): 3.9× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.6× to 2.6× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.3 to 8.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (73.9 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 72.6 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.6 %, cost 150×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is xHigh (73.1 %, cost 94×): 1.6× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 16× to 24× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 10.0 to 13.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (73.9 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.9 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.9 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (65.5 %, cost 29×): 2.0× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 8.4× to 12× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 4.9 to 8.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.6 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.9 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.9 %, cost 15×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (66.4 %, cost 23×): 1.6× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.2 vs Fable 5.1: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.2 costs 0.7× to 1.3× what Fable 5.1 costs and scores 6.0 to 7.5 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Fable 5.2 at max (76.5 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.5 %. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.5 %, cost 327×), the cheapest Fable 5.2 setting is low (71.8 %, cost 58×): 5.7× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 2.4 to 3.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.5 %): Fable 5's best is max at 67.7 %. To match Fable 5 at max (67.7 %, cost 333×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is medium (67.0 %, cost 101×): 3.3× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.3× what Opus 5 costs and scores 2.2 to 5.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (73.9 %): Opus 5's best is max at 68.9 %. To match Opus 5 at max (68.9 %, cost 183×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (70.1 %, cost 42×): 4.3× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 8.1 to 12.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (72.6 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 59.9 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (59.9 %, cost 133×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (61.7 %, cost 16×): 8.2× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
